text: 1、市场早间低开高走，科创50指数涨超5%。半导体芯片股集体走强，中巨芯、正帆科技、金海通、大为股份等多股涨停。贵金属板块拉升，四川黄金涨停。PCB概念股走高，中京电子、华正新材等涨停。智能驾驶概念活跃，索菱股份、浙江世宝、兴民智通等涨停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超3900股飘红，上午半天成交1.7万亿。午间收盘沪指涨1.34%，深成指涨1.56%，创业板涨0.89%。 2、板块概念方面，半导体芯片、贵金属、算力硬件、消费电子等板块领涨；油气、银行、白酒、中药等板块逆势下跌； 3、两市共3631只个股上涨，89只个股涨停；1351只个股下跌，2只个股跌停
text_en: 1. Markets opened lower and rallied in the morning session, with the STAR 50 Index up over 5%. Semiconductor chip stocks strengthened broadly, with Zhongju Core, Zhengfan Technology, Jinhaitong, Dawei Co., and others hitting limit-up. Precious metals gained, with Sichuan Gold hitting limit-up. PCB concept stocks rose, with Zhongjing Electronics and Huazheng New Materials hitting limit-up. Intelligent driving concepts were active, with Suoling Shares, Zhejiang Shibao, and Xingmin Zhitong hitting limit-up. Rising stocks outnumbered decliners, with over 3,900 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing up, and morning turnover reached RMB 1.7 trillion. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.34%, Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.56%, and ChiNext rose 0.89%. 2. Leading sectors included semiconductor chips, precious metals, computing hardware, and consumer electronics, while oil and gas, banks, baijiu, and traditional Chinese medicine fell against the trend. 3. Across the two exchanges, 3,631 stocks rose with 89 hitting limit-up, while 1,351 fell with 2 hitting limit-down.
